law.catch_line: Waiver of cancellation upon dissolution; reinstatement of series limited liability company

text.section:
If after dissolution the members of a series limited liability company waive the right to have the series limited liability company's affairs wound up and its existence canceled:
Each protected series of the series limited liability company ceases winding up; and
The provisions of § 13.1-1047.1 stating the results of the waiver apply to each protected series of the series limited liability company in accord with § 13.1-1094.

A protected series that has ceased to exist may have its existence reinstated in accordance with § 13.1-1050.4 as if it were a limited liability company, provided that the series limited liability company that established the protected series is in existence.
